children: Paradium.AI announced a 10-year strategic platform agreement with Roundtable and a related private equity purchase leaving Roundtable with ~49.5% ownership if closed.
Paradium.AI entered a 10-year Platform Agreement with Roundtable to provide tech, monetization and operating services.
Roundtable will assume substantial operating functions and costs for Paradium.AI’s media brands, reducing Paradium.AI’s expenses.
Roundtable will receive revenue share and a worldwide, perpetual license to certain Paradium.AI technology assets; Paradium.AI retains IP ownership.
Roundtable agreed to buy Paradium.AI shares from Simplify at $3.80/share, resulting in ~49.5% ownership for Roundtable and ~23.1% for Simplify.
Transactions are subject to closing conditions, including Roundtable funding and Nasdaq price requirements, and expected to close in Q4 2026.
